summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the whole watchlist read/write path before writing this plan, since a "why do lists vanish" bug needs a concrete hypothesis, not just process.  **What I found, contrary to the ticket's framing:** the backend and client wiring both look correctly scoped to the signed-in user. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` scopes every query by `user_id` from the session (`watchlists.user_id`, enforced on every route via `and(eq(watchlists.id, id), eq(watchlists.user_id, userId))`). - The session cookie (`arca_session`, 30-day expiry, `httpOnly`
